ai_positioning.summary: Okta se positionne comme un leader potentiel dans la gestion de l'identité pour les agents IA et les identités non humaines (NHI), anticipant une nouvelle vague de demande liée à l'IA.
evidence: Okta Platform and Auth0 Platform enable our customers to securely connect the right people to the right technologies and services at the right time.
the emergence of artificial intelligence ( AI ) and the deployment of AI agents may, over time, create new opportunities for identity management.

We see a potential long-term opportunity for our platforms to serve as a unified, independent control plane for non-human identities ( NHIs ) and AI agents, a distinct class of identity that requires authenticated, secure access to sensitive resources at a scale and speed exceeding traditional security models designed for human users.
We are expanding these capabilities to include AI agents with the introduction of new product offerings currently in development and early access.
